title: Bouqueting Flowers: Anvil
description: Rename flowers to turn them into bouquets!
body:
This pack lets you rename any flower in an anvil to turn it into a bouquet item!
<hr>

To get a bouquet, rename the flower "_Flower Type_ Bouquet", so for example with oxeye daisies it would be "Oxeye Daisy Bouquet" (see gallery for a visual example).

There are also mixed tulip bouquets with three of any color tulip together! You can make a mixed tulip bouquet by renaming a tulip "_FST_ Tulip Bouquet", as in first color initial, second color initial, third color initial. You also need to use the first color tulip as the one you rename. So for example, if you wanted a mixed tulip bouquet where the first color was orange, the second color was pink, and the third color was red, you would rename an orange tulip "OPR Tulip Bouquet". (see visual example and which tulips in the bouquet are first, second, third in the gallery).
<hr>

It's perfect for gifts to friends or as decoration :)

<hr>
An important note is that the change only applies to the item texture, and not what it looks like when it's placed. Also, if placed, the flower will lose its name and no longer be a bouquet if picked back up.
<hr>

There is also an [alternate version](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bouqueting-flowers-workbench) that is a datapack/mod where you can craft the bouquet in a crafting table instead!
